messages:
Olivia: Quick question for the people who travel a ton  toiletries: pack full-size stuff in checked or plan to buy on-site? I hate schlepping liquids but also hate hunting for toothpaste at midnight. :grimacing:
Marco: I usually pack travel-size basics in a small dopp kit and buy anything I cant find at the hotel. Saves space + less risk on the plane.
Jin: If its a short offsite (2-3 days) I go minimal: toothbrush, mini toothpaste, deodorant. Everything else I buy if needed.
Aisha: Pro tip: get reusable silicone travel bottles and fill with your preferred shampoo/condo. Less waste and no weird hotel soap surprises.
Olivia: Do you check bags for the extra liquids? Im trying to avoid checked luggage for cost reasons.
Marco: No checked bags. I do carry-on only. Use a toiletry bag that meets 3-1-1 and stash the rest in the hotel fridge if needed (weird but works).
Jin: Also keep a little sealed bag with wet wipes and a toothbrush travel paste packet. Those are lifesavers for overnight flights.
Aisha: If youre going international, check local brands first. Some countries sell great mini kits for cheap and you avoid lugging tons.
Olivia: Poll: carry full-size in checked / travel-size carry-on / buy on site / mix-and-match  react with emoji
Marco: ":package:" for checked
Jin: ":handbag:" for travel-size carry-on
Aisha: ":globe_with_meridians:" for buy on site
Olivia: ":arrows_counterclockwise:" for mix-and-match
ops-bot: Reminder: Check customs rules for liquids for international travel. See #help/travel-checklist for the 3-1-1 guide. :robot_face:
Marco: Mini hack: put a small zip-top bag with a printed list of items you might need to buy locally (razor, sunscreen, etc.) so you dont end up buying doubles.
Jin: If youre eco-conscious, pack a solid shampoo bar. No liquids, lasts forever, and TSA-friendly.
Aisha: Meme: "my bag: i will be light this trip"
"also my bag at packing: 12 tiny bottles and a spare hairdryer" (image)
Olivia: Thanks all. Looks like Ill do travel-size + one small backup from hotel shop. Also ordering a silicone bottle set because Aisha convinced me.
Marco: Good call. If you forget anything, ping me  I always carry extra toothpaste packets.
Olivia: @here anyone want to meet at 6:30pm in the lobby for a quick evening check-in and bag swap station?
